Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.

    Title: Duty of driver to avoid driving while fatigued
    Definition: A person must not drive a fatigue-regulated heavy vehicle on a road while the person is impaired by fatigue.

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.

  Rule ID: RS-1.10

  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.9

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

  Rule ID: RS-1.4

  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

  Rule ID: RS-1.7

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

  Rule ID: RS-1.7

  Rule ID: RS-1.9

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10

  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4

    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays

  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

  Rule ID: RS-1.7

  Rule ID: RS-1.8

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Analyze the image against the rule set. If the rule set clearly applies to the scenario depicted, determine whether it is "Complied" or "Violated". If the rule set does not clearly apply, return "Not Applicable".

Rule Set: Vehicle Load (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Carrying goods in addition to a large indivisible items
    Definition: A load-carrying vehicle must not carry more than 1 large indivisible item.
    Source: HEAVY VEHICLE (MASS, DIMENSION AND LOADING) NATIONAL REGULATION - SCHEDULE 8 Division 2 - Load-carrying vehicles 13 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Load restraint requirement
    Definition: The following requirements apply to a vehicle that is carrying a load— (a) the load must be secured by a means that is appropriate to the vehicle and the nature of the load; (b) the load must be placed and secured on the vehicle in a way that prevents, or would be likely to prevent, the load or any part of the load from— (i) hanging or projecting from the vehicle; or (ii) becoming dislodged or falling from the vehicle; (c) the load must not be placed or secured on the vehicle in a way that makes the vehicle unstable; (d) the load must be placed and secured on the vehicle in compliance with the performance standards recommended in the Load Restraint Guide for Light Vehicles 2018, published by the National Transport Commission.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY (VEHICLES) REGULATIONS 2021 - REG 285
